title: The Horizon of the Empty Quarter
author: Mara Ishikawa
blurb: Beatrix Galloway, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
